summary: Phase 149O.20A -- HATP Deployment Readiness Architecture: ARCHITECTURE/DEPLOYMENT-READINESS DESIGN ONLY, directly chartered by 149O.19.5G's own section-14 recommendation. Read all eight bound contracts (HATP-001, HMRC-001, HMIC-001 v1.1, HSCE-001, RAE-001, RWMPC-001, PBPA-001, PBPC-001) in full plus the Chapter 149O architecture chain (1A, 1B/1B.1/1B.2/1B.3, 8, 14, 15, 17, 18A-F, 19, 19.1-19.5G), cross-checked against production source (hatp_bootstrap.py, repository_identity.py, hatp_mandatory_certification.py, hatp_mandatory_cutover.py, permission_broker_foundation.py). Reconstructed the deployment trust model (agent/admin OS principals, Protected Root, HMIC certification state, Cutover Record) with owner/reader/writer/authority/mutability for each entity. Froze the Class-B principal-separation topology (two OS principals, inherited unmodified from 149O.1B.1) and extended it with a new admin-locked-agent-Python-environment requirement (DRA-REQ-003) motivated directly by the HMIC-REQ-063 disposition. Selected the installation model (Model A -- editable install from the canonical repository working tree, the only topology HMIC-REQ-064 certifies) as a Decision Record. Dispositioned HMIC-REQ-063 as OPTION C -- BLOCKING ONLY FOR SOME DEPLOYMENT MODELS: accepted as a residual limitation under Model A only when the agent's Python import search path is admin-provisioned and agent-unwritable; blocking for any deployment where the agent OS principal can write to its own import search path. Compared nine candidate executed-source-binding designs without selecting or implementing any. Derived the full HMIC certification bootstrap sequence (10 ordered steps), a deployment-update state-machine vocabulary (DEPLOYED_UNCERTIFIED/CERTIFIED_INACTIVE/CERTIFIED_ACTIVE/READY/HATP_MANDATORY, descriptive labels only, not overloading HMRC-001's own CutoverMode), a 10-row operational-readiness matrix mapping every reachable combination of implementation/Class-B/environment-lock/signer/certification/binding/readiness/cutover/PB/runtime facts to its maximum legitimate claim, and applied it to this host's current real state (SYSTEM IMPLEMENTATION VERIFIED -- DEPLOYMENT NOT READY). Froze recovery/migration/backup/disaster-recovery semantics, an 11-item deployment-readiness requirement inventory (DRA-REQ-001..011), a 15-entry deployment-specific attack matrix, and nine stop conditions (DRA-S1..S9), all explicitly evaluated NOT TRIGGERED. Wrote docs/PHASE_149O_20A_HATP_DEPLOYMENT_READINESS_ARCHITECTURE.md (104 numbered sections) and tests/test_phase_149o_20a_hatp_deployment_readiness_architecture.py (17 tests, all passed), mechanically verifying the architecture document's structural completeness -- required section presence, the three central Decision Records, all nine stop conditions explicitly marked NOT TRIGGERED, the future-phase sequence, and the production-boundary confirmations. Zero src/pcae/**, zero scripts/**, and zero docs/contracts/** files changed -- confirmed all eight bound contracts byte-unchanged at exit via direct git-diff inspection. Cross-check regression (pytest -k 'hmic or hatp_mandatory or 149o_19'): 7 failed, 1222 passed -- A/B confirmed via a detached git worktree at the pre-phase commit (identical 7 failing node IDs at both commits; pass-count delta is exactly this phase's own new tests matching the -k filter). Fast Green serial run: 20 failed, 6336 passed, 1 skipped, 25639 deselected -- A/B confirmed via the same pre-phase-commit worktree (identical 20 failing node IDs; one additional baseline-only node is itself flaky across runs, not a regression). Clean deselected Fast Green run: 0 failed, 6335 passed, 1 skipped, 25639 deselected. Verdict: HATP DEPLOYMENT READINESS ARCHITECTURE: COMPLETE -- IMPLEMENTATION VERIFIED -- REAL DEPLOYMENT NOT AUTHORIZED -- REAL ACTIVATION NOT AUTHORIZED. No real Class-B provisioning, certification, binding, revocation, Cutover Record, or activation marker was created anywhere on this host. HATP production remains NOT READY. Runtime remains Observed / observe / unavailable. Recommended next phase: 149O.20B -- HATP Class-B Deployment Contract Freeze.
